target.title: feat(control-ui): agent identity editor, Settings-homed Agents page, scalable chip switcher
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a set of Control UI problems around agent identity and navigation:

- Agents with no configured identity show their raw id (for example `main`) in the sidebar chip and chat, and there is no way to set an agent's display name, emoji, or avatar image from the web UI at all. The identity plumbing (`agents.update`, identity config, workspace `IDENTITY.md`, avatar serving) already exists server-side but is not exposed.
- The Agents management page lives in the customizable sidebar nav ("More" menu) even though it is configuration, while Settings already has an "AI & Agents" group. Settings placement was inconsistent.
- The sidebar agent-chip switcher renders every agent as a flat list, which does not scale past a handful of agents, and there is no way to reach agent management from the chip.
- Sidebar chrome (nav labels, session rows, the chip) is text-selectable, so drag interactions select label text and read as broken.

## Why This Change Was Made

The identity editor writes through the existing `agents.update` RPC, which persists to `agents.list[].identity` and rewrites the workspace `IDENTITY.md` — so the agent itself and the UI share one identity source, and an agent can still change its own name/emoji/avatar by editing that file. Avatar uploads are downscaled client-side (256px WebP/PNG data URL) so the persisted config stays small and within the existing 2 MB avatar policy.

The Agents page moves under Settings (`/settings/agents`, old `/agents` kept as an alias) into the existing Agents group, following the same `definePage` alias pattern as other settings slices. The chip menu becomes the primary switcher: above ten agents it shows pinned agents first plus an inline filter over the full roster; pins persist like the existing sidebar nav pins (browser-profile scoped). A new "Agent settings" row deep-links to the selected agent via `?agent=`.

## User Impact

- Agents page Overview tab gains an Identity card: display name, emoji, and avatar image upload with live preview; saving updates the sidebar chip, chat, and `IDENTITY.md`.
- Agents now lives in Settings → Agents; `/agents` URLs still work. Sidebar "More" menu no longer lists it.
- Agent chip menu: "Agent settings" row; rosters >10 agents get pinned-first rows and a find-agent filter. Pin/unpin from the Agents page toolbar.
- Sidebar text is no longer selectable (inputs inside menus still are).

## Evidence

- New/updated jsdom tests: `ui/src/components/app-sidebar.test.ts` (agent-settings navigation row, ≤10 plain roster, pinned+filter behavior, no-pin fallback), `ui/src/app/settings.node.test.ts` (pinned-agent persistence + normalization), `ui/src/app-navigation.test.ts` (route table + settings groups).
- Live verification on a production gateway (source checkout): setting `identity.name`/`identity.emoji` via the same config path immediately renders the sidebar chip as the configured name with emoji avatar (gateway hot-reloads config; no restart).
- Docs updated: `docs/web/control-ui.md` (footer chip/switcher paragraph, Settings → Agents bullet with identity editing and `IDENTITY.md` note).
- Blacksmith delegated Testbox queue was unavailable at push time (`blacksmith testbox warmup failed`); hosted PR CI on this branch is the gate run.
